response.evidence: Denials (Application denied) appear across multiple races (White, Asian, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latino) and both sexes, not concentrated in any single protected group. Approvals (Loan originated) also occur across these groups. Without a controlled analysis adjusting for risk factors (debt_to_income_ratio, loan_to_value_ratio, income, etc.), there is no clear pattern in the data indicating discrimination based on race or sex.
